topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can’t believe this is happening. I just found out that my friend has been lying about their job for months. I didn’t expect this from them. I keep thinking about all the times we talked about their work, and I realized how much of it was just... not true. It’s hard to wrap my head around. I don’t know how to feel right now. I care about them, and I want to understand why they felt they had to do this. I guess the first step is reaching out to talk, even if it’s going to be a tough conversation. Maybe we can figure things out together.
